verdict.rationale: The only first-party evidence of bulk operations is that the Bolna CLI manages "batches" alongside agents, calls and phone numbers. That implies a batch construct, presumably for running many calls at once, but the docs here do not describe what batches do or how they scale. The marketing claim of thousands of calls per minute and the workflow sequences are about throughput and orchestration, not bulk operations, so they are not credited. Missing for 10: documented batch-operation semantics (e.g. bulk call upload/launch from a list), bulk edits or deletes across agents or other items, API/MCP documentation of batch endpoints, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
